strings.모험가님께서 제 부탁을 들어주신다니 감사드려요. 미르를 위한 음식을 준비: Thank you for agreeing to help, adventurer. I want to prepare some food for Mir. Is that all right?
strings.저는 괜찮아요, 하르모니아. 그러면 이야기해주시겠어요?: Of course, Harmonia. Tell me about it.
If you've spoken with Mir, you'll know.
Mir is a Pluton dragon, but has a form close to a human's.
strings.어릴 적 약하게 태어났지만, 시스터와 정령들의 도움으로 극복하면서 새로운: Born frail, Mir overcame that weakness with help from the Sisters and spirits, and began living in a new form.
strings.제나디아에 남아있던 세레스 여신님의 힘이 미르에겐 축복이었죠. 그리고 신: The power Goddess Seres left in Xenadia was a blessing for Mir. With those mysterious abilities came a calling, which Mir accepted.
strings.정령들과 대화하고, 신의 계시를 받아 메시지를 전달하고…. 아직 어린아이: Speaking with spirits, receiving divine revelations, delivering messages... It's a great burden for someone so young, but Mir does it wonderfully.
That's why I wanted to give a gift: Mir's favorite food.
strings.와, 정령이 만드는 음식! 기대되는데요!: Wow, food made by a spirit! That sounds exciting!
strings.하지만 문제가 살짝 있답니다. 저는 '조화'와 '안정'의 정령왕. 요리하: But there's a small problem. I'm the Spirit King of Harmony and Stability. I can't leave this troubled Inner World to cook.
And even if I made something, I don't think I could achieve the flavor Mir wants. I drink natural spiritual essence, but have never eaten prepared food.
So, when all's said and done, you can't cook.
strings.맛없는 음식을 만들어서 주느니 차라리 맛있는 음식을 구해서 전달하는 게: Getting something delicious is wiser than making something that tastes bad.
I'd like you to obtain some food for Mir.
Mir once told me about passing a restaurant in Elias.
strings.맛있는 음식 냄새를 맡아서 먹어보고 싶었는데, 바빠서 들어가지 못했다고…: The food smelled wonderful. Mir wanted to try it, but said there was no time to go inside...
strings.하지만, 미르는 그 당시에 바쁜게 아니었어요. 정령도, 드래곤도, 인간의: But Mir wasn't actually busy. People's startled reactions to a form neither spirit, dragon, nor human were frightening.
I want to offer the food Mir couldn't try then.
I'll get it. I know where the restaurant in Elias is.
strings.미르에게 한 접시는 많이 아쉬울테니 그 요리를 두 접시 가져다 주셨으면: One plate would hardly satisfy Mir. Please bring two. I'm sure Mir will love it.
I'm sure it'll be enjoyed. I'll be back.
strings.엘리아스의 레스토랑에서 만든 음식!!: Food from that restaurant in Elias!
strings.재료는 뭔지 모르겠지만, 하여튼 맛있는 이 음식!! 비싸다고 들었는데,: I don't know the ingredients, but it's that delicious food! I heard it's expensive. How did you get it?
strings.(하르모니아가 미르를 위해 대신 음식을 부탁한 이야기를 들려준다.): (You explain that Harmonia asked you to bring food for Mir.)
Lady Harmonia, sniff... What a relief you didn't cook it yourself...
Anyway, give it here. I want to eat!
It cooled a little on the way from Jiendia. It should still taste good.
strings.식었다구요? 괜찮아요. 문제없어요. 여기 불의 정령들이 데워줄 테니까요!: It's cold? That's fine! The fire spirits can warm it up!
strings.(미르가 불의 정령을 불러 식은 음식이 담긴 접시를 잠시 들고 있으라고: (Mir calls a fire spirit and asks it to hold the plate of cooled food for a moment.)
strings.(불의 정령이 음식이 담긴 접시를 들고 있다가 다시 미르에게 돌려준다.): (The fire spirit holds the plate, then returns it to Mir.)
A fire spirit isn't a microwave, you know...
strings.아틀란티스에 그런 기기가 있다고 듣긴 했어요. 어쨌든 데워졌으니!! 그럼: I've heard Atlantis has those machines. Anyway, it's warm now! Let's eat!
strings.(미르가 음식을 입안으로 모두 밀어 넣는다.): (Mir stuffs all the food into their mouth.)
strings.맛이 없어요? 음식은 아주 맛있게 잘 된 것 같은데? 맛을 봐도 별 문제: Does it taste bad? It looks perfectly cooked. I tried it, and there's nothing wrong. What's the matter?
strings.인간적으로, 아니. 정령적으로, 아니. 드래곤적으로…. 하여튼! 쭈꾸미는: Humanly speaking... no, spiritually... no, dragon-wise... Anyway! Baby octopuses are horrible!
strings.예전에 신탁을 받아 어떤 지역의 정리를 잘해야 한다고 메시지를 전달하러: I once received a revelation and went to deliver a message that a certain region needed putting in order...
strings.거기에 끔찍한 쭈꾸미 성인이 있었어요. 거기 You, 날 보러 온 거군요: There was a horrible Octopus Alien there. 'Hey, you! Came to see me, baby? Careful not to fall for my gorgeous looks.' Ugh.
strings.이런 이야기를 며칠 동안 붙잡혀서 듣는다고 생각해보세요. 거기다 이상한: Imagine being trapped listening to that for days! And there were strange cats everywhere, too. It was mental torture.
Waaah... That octopus... Urgh. Just thinking about that smarminess makes me sick...
He is a little smarmy, but enough to make Mir refuse food...? Just how much did he torment you?
...I'll eat anything else you bring. Just get that octopus away from me.
All right. Hmm. Is that the end of this? It doesn't feel right...
Hate octopuses... Disgusting. Drop dead... You sea squirt, sea cucumber, anemone...
strings.음식을 먹다 말고 엎어질 정도면 심각한 건데…. 아, 일단 하르모니아에게: Collapsing in the middle of a meal is serious... I'd better discuss this with Harmonia. I can't leave the job half done...
strings.모험가님? 표정이 별로 좋아 보이지 않는데, 미르에게 무슨 일이라도 있는: Adventurer? You don't look happy. Has something happened to Mir?
strings.(미르가 쭈꾸미 볶음을 먹다 쭈꾸미 성인에게 시달린 기억을 떠올렸다고 말: (You explain that eating stir-fried octopus reminded Mir of being tormented by the Octopus Alien.)
What an interesting person. But if Mir suffered so much, he must have gone too far.
strings.네, 잠깐이지만요. 제가 알던 어떤 분을 따라 한 것 같은 다른 별의 주: Yes, briefly. He's from another planet, and seems to imitate someone I knew.
strings.(그러고 보니 사이암…. 사이암은 어떻게 된 거지? 내가 뭔가 잊고 있는: (Come to think of it, Siam... What happened to Siam? I feel like I'm forgetting something...)
Oh, my mind wandered for a moment.
strings.미르가 정령이라 하더라도 반은 살아있는 생명이에요. 그래서 조금 쉬게 하: Though Mir is a spirit, half is still a living creature. A little rest would help.
strings.모험가님께서 한 번 더 수고해주셨으면 해요. 죄송해요…. 미르에게 잘: I'm sorry to ask you to go to more trouble... I only wanted to do something nice for Mir...
strings.미르도 이해할 거예요. 그러면 이제 어떻게 하면 좋을까요?: Mir will understand. What should we do now?
I can't think of anything quite as fancy as that special stir-fried octopus...
strings.인간은 고향의 음식을 그리워한다는 이야길 들었어요. 이리스 님도 벨로스에: I've heard humans long for food from home. Lady Iris also wanted a good meal in Belos.
Xenadia Gardens. A place divided between land and water.
strings.모험가님, 미르와 저를 위해서 가주실 수 있으신가요?: Would you go there for Mir and me, adventurer?
strings.네, 갈 수 있긴 해요. 그런데 가서 누구한테 물어보죠?: I can, but who should I ask?
strings.어린 미르가 생명의 빛을 잃고 있을 때, 도와주신 신관이 계세요. 이름은: There's a priest who helped when young Mir's light of life was fading. I don't know the name, but they live in a place called the 'Chamber of Healing.'
strings.낯이 익은 모험가군. 잘 있었나?: A familiar adventurer. Have you been well?
Well... I feel like I do, and also like I don't...
Never mind. That isn't important now.
I heard Mir grew up here.
strings.(이리스의 심상세계를 방문하면서 미르를 만났던 이야기를 한다.): (You explain meeting Mir during your visits to Iris's Inner World.)
To think she would be the goddess... I must tell the priests and Sisters immediately.
strings.궁금한게 있어요. 이리스가 여신이 됐다면 신관과 시스터들이 자연스레 알아: I'm curious. If Iris became a goddess, shouldn't the priests and Sisters know naturally?
strings.네가 알지 모르겠지만, 제나디아는 시간의 흐름과 공간의 인식이 다른 장소: You may not know this, but time flows differently in Xenadia, as does the perception of space.
Just as the world cannot know everything about this place, this place cannot know everything about the world.
strings.여신님이 아직 오롯이 자신의 힘을 제어하지 못하시니 우리가 인식하지 못할: The goddess doesn't yet fully control her power. That may be why we haven't perceived her.
strings.어쨌든 지금 이걸 설명할 때가 아니지. 미르가 좋아할만한 음식이라…. 그: Anyway, this isn't the time for that explanation. Food Mir would like...? No need to think too hard.
strings.그 아이는 그저 많이 먹으면 되니까. 이곳에 널린 게 그 아이가 좋아하는: That child just needs plenty to eat. The place is full of favorite foods. Take all you like.
Where is the food? All I see are buildings and rocks...
strings.지하 정원에 보면 고구마랑 감자랑 잔뜩 있으니까 캐서 미르에게 가져다 줘: The underground garden has plenty of potatoes and sweet potatoes. Dig some up and take them to Mir.
strings.여신님과 정령의 축복을 잔뜩 받는 아이라 재료째 줘도 상관없을 거야. 알: With all those blessings from the goddess and spirits, raw ingredients will be fine. Mir can boil or roast them.
strings.미르는 네가 자신을 위해 제나디아에 온 것만 말해도 기뻐할 거야. 그 아: Just saying you came to Xenadia for Mir will be enough to bring joy. That child treasures anyone who cares.
I will. Thank you, Priest. I feel I should give you something...
strings.거기 맛있는 냄새가 나는 음식이 있는 것 같은데, 혹시 육포야?: You've got something that smells delicious. Is it jerky?
Oh, this is jerky from Lumen.
strings.나도 몇 개 주겠어? 흐음…. 이거 맛있군. (질겅질겅): Could I have a few pieces? Hmm... Delicious. Chew, chew.
But you're already eating it... Sigh. All right, take it all. Thank you, anyway.
strings.그런 거 가지고 뭘. 나중에 또 보자고. (질겅질겅), 이 육포 상당히: Think nothing of it. See you again. Chew, chew... This is excellent jerky. Chew, chew.
strings.쭈꾸미 싫어…. 더러워, 불결해, 징그러워…. 으윽: Hate octopuses... Filthy, foul, disgusting... Urgh...
strings.아직도 그래요? 괜찮아요?: Still like that? Are you all right?
So you're still not feeling well.
I'm fine. Food will fix me right up. As long as it isn't octopus.
strings.감자와 고구마…. 흐음. 물 냄새가 가득한 걸 보니 그곳에서 가져오셨군요: Potatoes and sweet potatoes... Hmm. They smell of water. You brought them from there.
It brought back memories of living there.
No. I was always happy. Everyone cared for me so warmly.
strings.그래도 신관님들이 해주신 음식은 맛이 없었…. 아무래도 드래곤 입맛이시라: Though the priests' cooking didn't taste good... They have dragon tastes, so they mostly ate things raw.
strings.제 입맛은 뭐랄까, 인간보다 더 민감해요. 유난히 많이 먹는 것도 그런: My palate is more sensitive than a human's, I suppose. That may be why I eat so much.
strings.하여튼 감사드려요. 그 많은 걸 들고 오셨으니 무거우실텐데. 자, 저에게: Anyway, thank you. Carrying all of that must have been heavy. Give it here. I'll eat it all.
strings.그냥 먹어도 돼요? 요리 안해도?: You can eat it just like that? Without cooking?
Of course not. The fire and water spirits here will help.
strings.(불과 물의 정령들이 낑낑대며 감자와 고구마를 가져간다.): (The fire and water spirits struggle to carry away the potatoes and sweet potatoes.)
strings.그러면 뭘 만들어볼까? 치즈가 있으니까 그라탱을 만들어보자! 불과 물의: What should we make? We have cheese, so let's make gratin! Fire and water spirits, please!
strings.자, 모험가님! 여기 치즈 감자 그라탱 있으니 하나 드시고 가세요. 나머: Here, adventurer! Have a cheese and potato gratin before you go. The rest are mine, so hands off.
strings.(미르가 치즈 감자 그라탱 수십 접시가 놓여져 있는 걸 보고 만족스러운: (Mir looks satisfied at the dozens of plates of cheese and potato gratin.)
Thank you. Enjoy your meal. And be good to Lady Harmonia.
Hehe. Of course! And adventurer... I'm counting on you from now on, too.
